findings.title: Dependency versions pinned
findings.evidence: Packages declared without an exact version, and no lockfile to record one -- requirements.txt: jupyter, numpy, pandas, sklearn, sqlalchemy.

remediation.description: Pin each dependency in requirements.txt to an exact version placeholder because no lockfile is present and the current file uses unpinned package names.
remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('requirements.txt')
lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
fixed = []
for line in lines:
    pkg = line.strip()
    if not pkg:
        fixed.append(line)
    elif '==' in pkg:
        fixed.append(pkg)
    else:
        fixed.append(f"{pkg}==<PINNED_VERSION>")
p.write_text('\n'.join(fixed) + ('\n' if fixed else ''))
PY
